panels.reading_guide: Arrows denote data flow, not better/worse. Input-origin channels are not a third spatial dimension. Equal unit gains reproduce normalized quadratic correction.

panels.title: Learning loss observed ranges
panels.reading_guide: Lower loss is a closer fit to the stated training objective. Translucent bands span observed minima and maxima in adjacent windows; they are continuous observed ranges, not confidence intervals. Empty windows leave visible gaps.
